text: Cattle need energy for several purposes: maintenance (digestion, breathing, temperature regulation); pregnancy (more energy needed in the final month before delivery as the fetus grows fast); lactation (energy deficiency reduces milk yield and forces the cow to draw on body reserves, becoming thin); fattening (spare energy goes to weight gain); and work (e.g. ploughing rice fields demands a lot of energy — underfed cattle lose condition and work more slowly). Energy sources: cellulose (forage and straw fiber, with high-quality forage giving good supplementary energy), starch (cassava root, corn, bran), and fat (rice bran).
